intervals.label: proposed at PSI; precursor phase in preparation
intervals.note: Start is the date of the concept paper. As of September 2024 the first phase was to demonstrate the frozen-spin technique "by 2026" and the ultimate goal was a factor 100 improvement by the early 2030s; no approval, construction or data-taking date was found.
intervals.quote: We propose the first dedicated muon EDM search employing the frozen-spin technique at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), Switzerland

placements.note: Planned placement at the PSI campus-grade site; the muon beam area is not located in a fetched source.
placements.quote: We propose the first dedicated muon EDM search employing the frozen-spin technique at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), Switzerland

summary.plain: A magnet in which muons circle while an electric field cancels the usual spin turning, with detectors that watch for a leftover turning that would show an electric dipole moment.
summary.technical: Frozen-spin storage solenoid with a radial electric field and positron tracking; precursor phase with 28 MeV/c muons, second phase with 125 MeV/c muons.
